intro: Iceland has a huge cultural output for its size, from ancient sagas to Björk and Sigur Rós.

chapters.title: Sagas and music
text: The medieval sagas are Iceland's greatest treasure. Björk, Sigur Rós, Of Monsters and Men and Laufey are among Iceland's internationally famous musicians.

chapters.title: Traditions and food
text: At Christmas, 13 mischievous 'Yule Lads' visit children, one each night. Traditional winter foods include fermented shark, while skyr, a thick yoghurt-like dairy food, and lamb are everyday favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: A thick, high-protein Icelandic dairy product.
